Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Laleli and Ortaköy are in the same district (Fatih). In reality, Laleli is in the Fatih district, while Ortaköy is in the Beşiktaş district. This geographical error led to the false conclusion that the two landmarks are in the same neighborhood (or even the same district), when they are actually in different districts entirely. The error occurred in the "Comparison of Locations" step where the Planner synthesized the search results.
